use.title: View Nomad
use.description: Read workloads, cluster resources, task logs and files; parse and plan jobs.

manage.title: Manage Nomad workloads
manage.description: Deploy and operate workloads, services, storage and variables. Nomad ACLs must also allow each action.

exec.title: Execute in Nomad tasks
exec.description: Open interactive commands in running allocations. Grants remote code execution within task privileges.

administer.title: Administer Nomad
administer.description: Manage cluster nodes, node pools, namespaces, ACLs and security configuration; inspect agent diagnostics.

enable.label: Enable Nomad
enable.description: Connect this host to a Nomad HTTP API endpoint. No SSH commands or Nomad installation are performed.

address.label: Nomad API URL
address.description: Absolute HTTP(S) origin, e.g. https://nomad.internal:4646. Empty uses http://<host IP>:4646. Accessible from the Termix backend, not your browser.

token.label: Nomad ACL token
token.description: Encrypted by Termix; used only by the backend. Leave empty only for a cluster without ACLs. Prefer HTTPS or a trusted private network.

nomadUiUrl.label: Nomad UI URL
nomadUiUrl.description: Optional browser-accessible HTTP(S) Nomad UI URL. Separate from the backend API address; no credentials or tokens in the URL. Login to Nomad UI separately.

consulAddress.label: Consul API URL
consulAddress.description: Optional Consul HTTP(S) endpoint reachable from Termix. Empty disables Consul status. This is separate from the Nomad endpoint.

consulToken.label: Consul read-only ACL token
consulToken.description: Separate encrypted Consul token with node/service read access. Never use the Nomad token or a Consul management token.

consulUiUrl.label: Consul UI URL
consulUiUrl.description: Optional browser-accessible HTTP(S) Consul UI URL. No credentials or tokens in the URL; login separately in Consul UI.
